title: OpenTelemetry events of a session go to a local file and join the transcript by id
goal: A documented setting turns on CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY with a console or file exporter and tool details off, so tool_result and api_request events (duration, sizes, cost, prompt.id, tool_use_id) land in a local file outside the repository; a read-only command joins them to a transcript by tool_use_id and request_id and prints cost per prompt, and no event text reaches the store or the API.

gates.question: Turn on Claude Code OpenTelemetry export to a local file for this project, tool details off?
